But what's beautiful is in the digital world, anybody can build a castle. Anybody can build a world. Anybody can build on the land, and there's infinite space to build. And you can keep building worlds within worlds, and they're all extraordinary. The best of the best. All elite-level design, all the highest levels of functions — and it feels like you're driving the Bugatti of the new NayaNET world. We don't call it the internet anymore — we call it NayaNET. It's a whole new world.
